WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM `order` AS o
  JOIN account AS a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE o.amount >= 2802
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - x.overall_avg AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS x
WHERE g.avg_amount > x.overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
